label: Find client threads and draft replies; never send, never file automatically
authored_by: RiskMandate, from Example Analytics's public pages, to be corrected
description: A small analytics consultancy would connect Gmail so the assistant can find a client's thread, summarise what was agreed and draft a reply for a consultant to send. Reading is what is wanted. Sending as the consultant, and setting up filters that keep running after the chat, are not.

notes.send.message.world: Refused: a reply to a client is the consultant's to send. Today only the per-action approval prompt stands in the way, which is a setting.
notes.read.message.tenant: wanted — and reads every message the account can already read, which is more than most people picture when they say "read my mail"
notes.create.schedule.tenant: refused; a filter is a rule that keeps acting on mail after the chat ends, and nobody asked for one

provenance.note: Written on this site as the starting mandate for a connector shape the model site has not published. A mandate is elicited, not measured: this is a first draft written to be argued with. `unstated` is the primitives the mandate names neither way.
